messages.content: In this competition, all participants' decks are transparent in the game logs. Couldn't a bot maker track every opponent and their deck composition? By combining this historical data with in-game card counting and deduction, a bot could map out the opponent's exact remaining deck. Wouldn't this create a significant unfair advantage when planning optimal moves?
